tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Scan a public domain and return the full scan record: score and its two parts, level, per-check status, evidence, and fingerprint. tools.name: get_score
tools.description: Return the stored scan record for a host. It starts no scan. A host with no stored record is answered with an error that says so.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: List the 60 checks of rubric v0.9 across 5 dimensions, each with its kind, module, dimension, and rationale. A scored check also has a part, a tier and a weight. An unscored check earns 0 points.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Return the markdown status report of a host's stored scan record, or one check of it by check id. It starts no scan.
